lead: Equipment and supplies for gardens and grounds, from mowers, hand tools and watering to greenhouses, pools and outdoor cooking, organised by garden task with tier lists for machines and archetypes for enthusiast tools.

depts.note: Pick the best machine: market-covering brands plus independent test winners.

b.w: Tests weigh this most: Which? gives it 50 to 51 percent and Consumer NZ tests long grass.

b.m: Battery run time and spare batteries
b.w: Consumer NZ found about 50 minutes; it is part of the Which? Best Buy rule.
Consumer NZ brand reliability survey and owner community reports.

s.brief: Tier shelf. Re-cut model lists to 5-12 per kind from market-covering brands (Honda, Mountfield, EGO, Stihl, Husqvarna, Hayter, Flymo, Bosch, Toro, John Deere) plus Which?/Consumer Reports/CHOICE test winners. Robotic: Husqvarna Automower, Segway Navimow, Mammotion, Worx Landroid, Stihl iMow. Cylinder mower: Allett/Atco, Hayter; vintage collector cylinder mowers (Ransomes, Atco Standard) may stay as a few archetypes with sources. Riding mower keeps types ride-on, lawn tractor, zero-turn.

k.brief: Types: push, self-propelled; petrol, cordless, corded.

s.brief: Tier shelf. String trimmer: test winners and market brands (Stihl, EGO, Ryobi, Bosch, Husqvarna, Makita). Hand tools (half-moon edger, grass shears): Burgon & Ball, Wilkinson Sword, Spear & Jackson, Gardena. Collapse trimmer line and mower blade into one 'Mower & trimmer spare parts' entry (no SKU list). Artificial turf: drop retailer SKUs (artificialgrass.ie lines), keep a few national brands (Namgrass, LazyLawn, TigerTurf) only if sourced.

k.brief: One entry: mower blades, trimmer line and spools, belts; no models.

depts.note: Hand tools are an enthusiast field (Swiss, Japanese and British makers); powered tools are tier.

s.brief: Variety shelf. Turn the 41-model secateur list into archetypes ordered by significance: Felco 2 (originator of the modern Swiss secateur; versions Felco 6, 8, 9 left-hand, 2e), Okatsune 103, Niwaki GR/Tobisho, ARS VS-8, Darlac compound, Wolf-Garten/Gardena ratchet, Bahco. Drop duplicate rows (Kent & Stowe listed twice) and retailer noise. Snips: Okatsune and Niwaki flower/bud snips (Hasami). Pruning knife: Opinel No. 8 garden, Victorinox grafting/pruning, Tina, Felco 600. Add a Japanese garden-blade tradition entry (Miki/Banshu Hamono, Sanjo) if sourced.

k.brief: Types: pruning, grafting, budding; fixed, folding.

s.brief: Variety at the saw end. Pruning saw archetypes: Silky Gomboy, Silky Zubat, Silky Pocketboy, Silky Hayauchi (pole), Niwaki, Bahco Laplander, Corona RazorTOOTH. Loppers: Felco 211/221, Okatsune 'loppers', Fiskars PowerGear, Wolf-Garten, ARS. Pole pruner: Fiskars, Gardena StarCut, Silky Hayauchi. Move the Ryobi powered range off pruning saw.

Variety shelf with traditions. Hedge shears: Niwaki/Okatsune topiary shears, Burgon & Ball, Jakoti, Darlac. Scythe: merge blade and snath into the scythe kind; archetypes Austrian (Schroeckenfux, Fux, Falci), American/English pattern; versions grass, ditch, bush blades; snath types (two-grip, Austrian, one-piece). Add an Austrian scythe-making tradition entry if sourced. Billhook: British regional patterns (Yorkshire, Devon, Llandeilo, Spar hook; Morris of Dunsford, Elwell), Italian Rinaldi patterns, French serpe. Sickle: Japanese kama (nokogiri-gama), grass hook. Machete: Tramontina, Imacasa/Condor, Fiskars, Gerber; note fighting machetes go to Weapons per knife rule.

k.brief: Blade and snath are types/versions, not separate kinds.

s.brief: Tier shelf. Cut model lists to 5-12 per kind across Stihl, Husqvarna, Echo, EGO, Makita, Ryobi, Bosch, Greenworks plus Which?/Consumer Reports test winners. Drop Fieldmann and Ozito unless a test winner. Multi-tool: Stihl KombiSystem, Husqvarna, EGO Multi-Head, Ryobi Expand-It (ranges).

depts.note: Hand tools are an enthusiast field (Sneeboer, DeWit, Bulldog, Niwaki); machines are tier.

s.brief: Variety shelf. Archetypes by pattern: border spade, digging spade, Irish/Lazy-bed spade, treaded spade, transplanting spade; Sneeboer, DeWit, Bulldog (Clarington Forge), Spear & Jackson Neverbend, Joseph Bentley, Burgon & Ball, Niwaki, Freund, Krumpholz. Mattock: drop A.M. Leonard trade SKUs, keep pick/cutter mattock patterns. Broadfork: Meadow Creature, Gardener's broadfork patterns.

Variety at the hand-tool end. Hoe archetypes: Dutch hoe, draw hoe, swan-neck, oscillating/stirrup, Sneeboer Royal Dutch, DeWit, Japanese nejiri gama, Glaser wheel hoe; wheel hoe (Glaser, Terrateck) belongs with hoes as a type. Rake: soil/landscape rake. Cultivator: CobraHead, Krumpholz. Tiller: tier list (Mantis, Honda, Stihl, Husqvarna, Einhell).

k.brief: Types: Dutch, draw, swan-neck, oscillating, wheel hoe.

s.brief: Variety shelf. Trowel archetypes: Sneeboer, DeWit, Burgon & Ball, Niwaki, Spear & Jackson; transplanting trowel, Sneeboer 'Great Dixter' series.
